reviews.author: Vridhi Kothari
reviews.body: Real mein pendant photos se bhi zyada attractive dikhta hai. Chain bhi comfortable hai aur overall quality impressive lagi.

reviews.author: Advik Rathod
reviews.body: Is budget mein itna classy pendant milna honestly unexpected tha. Har detail bahut achhe se finish ki gayi hai aur overall look bahut elegant lagta hai.

reviews.author: Inika Banerjee
reviews.body: Chain bhi kaafi comfortable hai aur poora din pehenne ke baad bhi bilkul heavy feel nahi hota. 😊

reviews.author: Ariv Dugar
reviews.body: Main generally minimal jewellery prefer karta hoon aur yeh pendant exactly meri choice ke according nikla. Design classy hai aur overdone bilkul nahi lagta.
